name: æ Policy
scope: Internet of Agents: machines, agents, robots, harnesses, surfaces, and commerce drafts

definitions.draft: Any task, claim, intent, QR, URL, listing, or agent message not signed by HUMAN://ROOT.
definitions.approval: An explicit human-root decision bound to an action hash, scope, and expiry.
definitions.machine: Any runtime, device, surface, robot, or harness that can observe or act.
definitions.receipt: A hash-chained record that makes an action visible after it happens.

rules.statement: HUMAN://ROOT is the only authority root.
Agents may propose; they may not authorize.
A QR is an address, not permission.
Read-only observation is allowed with an identified actor and a receipt.
Actuation requires human approval or an armed physical deadman.
Commerce and payment actions are drafts until the human signs.
External publication requires human approval and produces a public receipt.
Every allowed or denied decision writes a receipt to the unified ledger.
Unknown actions, missing actors, and expired approvals fail closed.

hermes-ae.obligation: Enforce this policy before dispatch; receipt every decision.

asimov-agent.obligation: Act only through a governed harness with human-root approval or deadman.

asimov-viewport.obligation: Project state read-only; never mutate authority or actuation.

commandprompt-ai.obligation: Render prompts and receipts; do not sign for the human.

privateclient-ai.obligation: Convert drafts into signed actions only through explicit human approval.

pi500-teleop.obligation: Motion requires arm plus deadman; every command is receipted.

android-mcp.obligation: Supply context and approval gestures; never become an authority root.

llm-store.obligation: Carts and checkout are drafts until human signs; identity stays private.

surfaces.display_rule: Every public surface must show the authority chain and state that authority is not transferable.

revocation.rule: Any machine may be revoked by HUMAN://ROOT; revocation is effective when a REVOKE receipt is chained.
